from collections import Counter,deque

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    bg=Counter(x for row in grid for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen=set(); components=[]
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
       if grid[r][c]==bg or (r,c) in seen: continue
       q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]
       while q:
        y,x=q.pop(); comp.append((y,x))
        for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
         if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and grid[yy][xx]!=bg and (yy,xx) not in seen:
          seen.add((yy,xx));q.append((yy,xx))
       components.append(comp)
    comp=max(components,key=len)
    st=set(comp)
    r0=min(r for r,c in comp); r1=max(r for r,c in comp)
    c0=min(c for r,c in comp); c1=max(c for r,c in comp)
    cr=(r0+r1)//2; cc=(c0+c1)//2
    targets=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]!=bg and (r,c) not in st]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    stamp=[(r-cr,c-cc,grid[r][c]) for r,c in comp]
    for tr,tc in targets:
      for dr,dc,color in stamp:
       rr,cc2=tr+dr,tc+dc
       if 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc2<w: out[rr][cc2]=color
    return out

for n,(a,b) in enumerate(pairs,1):
 out=transform(a)
 mismatch=[(r,c,out[r][c],b[r][c]) for r in range(len(b)) for c in range(len(b[0])) if out[r][c]!=b[r][c]]
 print(n,'match',not mismatch,'mismatches',mismatch[:10], 'count',len(mismatch))
